# PayloadsAllTheThings (fixture)

A list of useful payloads and bypasses for web application security.
Each technique links to its own page with payloads and exploitation notes.

This fixture is synthetic: every entry below is invented and points at
`example.test`. It models the upstream README's categorized index style,
where most entries are bare links without descriptions.
